about: Functions the clean-room specs explain, with what each does in plain words: Xbox (default.xbe) ones by their work-queue name, and PC (Scarface.exe 1.00.2) ones by address, whose Xbox twins do the same unless a spec says otherwise. 'status' is whether it is in reports/verified_registry.json. See docs/AGENTS.md.
